40001981.author: पदार्थः
40001981.content: तत: thereafter, प्रभाते at dawn, महर्षिभि: by maharshis, कृतकर्मा having performed daily (sacrificial) acts, वाक्यज्ञ: conversant in speech, जनक: Janaka, पुरोहितम् chief priest, शतानन्दम् Satananda, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.

40001981.author: Translation
40001981.content: Thereafter at dawn after the maharshis had performed their daily (sacrificial) rites the eloquent Janaka said to the chief priest Satananda:

40001982.author: पदार्थः
40001982.content: अतिधार्मिक: extremely righteous, कुशध्वज: इति  named Kusadhwaja, ख्यात: renowned, महातेजा: most brilliant, मम my, यवीयान् younger, भ्राता brother, इक्षुमतीम् named Ikshumati, नदीम् river, पिबन् drinking, वार्याफलकपर्यन्ताम् darts planted in water as boundary, शुभाम् auspicious, पुण्यसङ्काशाम् sacred, साङ्काश्यां पुरीम् named Sankasya, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, विमानमिव like chariot, अध्यवसत् is residing.

40001982.author: Translation
40001982.content: "The extremely righteous, renowned and most brilliant Kusadhwaja, my younger brother is (at present) ruling the sacred kingdom of Sankasya, which is like the aerial chariot Pushpaka, with darts planted in water as boundary on the bank of the auspicious, sacred river Ikshumati.

40001983.author: पदार्थः
40001983.content: अतिधार्मिक: extremely righteous, कुशध्वज: इति  named Kusadhwaja, ख्यात: renowned, महातेजा: most brilliant, मम my, यवीयान् younger, भ्राता brother, इक्षुमतीम् named Ikshumati, नदीम् river, पिबन् drinking, वार्याफलकपर्यन्ताम् darts planted in water as boundary, शुभाम् auspicious, पुण्यसङ्काशाम् sacred, साङ्काश्यां पुरीम् named Sankasya, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, विमानमिव like chariot, अध्यवसत् is residing.

40001983.author: Translation
40001983.content: "The extremely righteous, renowned and most brilliant Kusadhwaja, my younger brother is (at present) ruling the sacred kingdom of Sankasya, which is like the aerial chariot Pushpaka, with darts planted in water as boundary on the bank of the auspicious, sacred river Ikshumati.

40001984.author: पदार्थः
40001984.content: अहम् I, तम् him, द्रष्टुम् to behold, इच्छामि I am desiring, स: he, मे my, यज्ञगोप्ता protector of  the sacrifice, मत: has been accepted, महातेजा: most glorious, सोऽपि he also, मया सह with me, इमाम् this, प्रीतिम् pleasure, भोक्ता will enjoy.

40001984.author: Translation
40001984.content: I desire to see Kusadhwaja who I have accepted as the protector of the sacrifice. I want that my glorious brother should share this pleasure, with me".

40001985.author: पदार्थः
40001985.content: शतानन्दस्य Satananda's, सन्निधौ in the presence, एवम् thus, वचने words, उक्ते (सति) when he uttered, अव्यग्रा: undistracted, केचित् some (attendants), आगता: had come, जनक: Janaka, तान् them, समादिशत् commanded.

40001985.author: Translation
40001985.content: Janaka having said so in the presence of Satananda gave instructions to a few faithful  attendants who were present.

40001986.author: पदार्थः
40001986.content: नरेन्द्रस्य king Janaka's, शासनात् by the command, इन्द्राज्ञया by the order of Indra, विष्णुं यथा like Visnu, नरव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, समानेतुम् to bring him, शीघ्रवाजिभि: on swift moving steeds, प्रययु: rode away.

40001986.author: Translation
40001986.content: In obedience to the command of Indra among men (king Janaka), the messengers rode away on swift horses to bring king Kusadhwaja, a tiger among men just like fetching Visnu by the orders of Indra.

40001987.author: पदार्थः
40001987.content: ते those messengers, साङ्काश्याम् city of Sankasya, समागम्य having reached, कुशध्वजम् Kusadhwaja, ददृशुश्च beheld him, यथावृत्तम् as happened, जनकस्य Janaka's, चिन्तितम् intention, न्यवेदयन् च informed.

40001987.author: Translation
40001987.content: The messengers reached Sankasya, met Kusadhwaja and related to him what had happened. They informed him the intention of (king) Janaka.

40001988.author: पदार्थः
40001988.content: नृपति king, कुशध्वज: Kusadhwaja, महाबलै: by men endowed with strength, दूतश्रेष्ठै: by the loyal messengers, तत् that, वृत्तम् events, श्रुत्वा having learned, अथ thereafter, नरेन्द्रस्य king's, आज्ञया by order, आजगाम set out.

40001988.author: Translation
40001988.content: Kusadhwaja having heard the events from the loyal, mighty messengers set out for Mithila in compliance with the request of the king (Janaka).

40001989.author: पदार्थः
40001989.content: स: he, धर्मवत्सलम् devoted to righteousness, महात्मानम् magnanimous, जनकम् Janaka, ददर्श beheld, स: he, शतानन्दम् Satananda, धार्मिकम् virtuous, राजानं च king also, अभिवाद्य having saluted with reverence, राजार्हम् befitting a king, परमम् great, दिव्यम् excellent, आसनम् seat, अध्यरोहत occupied.

40001989.author: Translation
40001989.content: There he saw the highsouled Janaka devoted to righteousness. Having paid his regards to Satananda and the virtuous king he occupied an exalted seat befitting a king.

40001990.author: पदार्थः
40001990.content: अतितेजसौ possessing great splendour, तौ वीरौ those two heores, उभौ both, भ्रातरौ brothers, उपविष्टौ seated, मन्त्रिश्रेष्ठम् wisest of ministers, सुदामनम् Sudaman, प्रेषयामासतु: despatched.

40001990.author: Translation
40001990.content: The two heroic brothers endowed with great splendour seated beside each other, despatched Sudamana the wisest of ministers (to Dasaratha).

40001991.author: पदार्थः
40001991.content: मन्त्रिपते O Foremost of counsellors, शीघ्रम् speedily, गच्छ go, अमितप्रभम् immeasurable splendour, ऐक्ष्वाकुम् Ikshvaku king Dasaratha, दुर्धर्षम् invincible, समन्त्रिणम् together with ministers, आत्मजै: along with sons, समानयस्व bring him.

40001991.author: Translation
40001991.content: "O Foremost among counsellors, go speedily and bring along with his ministers and sons the invincible Dasaratha of the Ikshvakus dynasty whose splendour is immeasurable".

40001992.author: पदार्थः
40001992.content: स: he, औपकार्याम् tent, गत्वा having gone, रघूणाम् of the race of Raghus, कुलवर्धनम् perpetuating, ददर्श saw, एनम् him, शिरसा bowing down his head, अभिवाद्य having saluted him, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40001992.author: Translation
40001992.content: Having reached the tent, he (Sudamana) saw Dasaratha, perpetuator of the race of the Raghus and bowing down his head, said:

40001993.author: पदार्थः
40001993.content: वीर O Heroic one, अयोध्याधिपते O Lord of Ayodhya, मिथिलाधिप: lord of Mithila, वैदेह: Janaka, सोपाध्यायपुरोहितम् along with spiritual preceptors and chief priest, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, सः he, व्यवसित: has decided.

40001993.author: Translation
40001993.content: "O Heroic lord of Ayodhya, Janaka, the lord of Mithila desires to see you along with preceptors and priest".

40001994.author: पदार्थः
40001994.content: तदा then, राजा king, मंत्रिश्रेष्ठवच: the words of the best of counsellors, श्रुत्वा having listened, सर्षिगण: with hosts of rishis, सबंधु: with relations, जनक: Janaka, यत्र where, वर्तते was waiting, तत्र there, अगमत् went.

40001994.author: Translation
40001994.content: King Dasaratha on hearing the words of the best of the counsellors reached the place where Janaka was waiting with hosts of rishis and relations.

40001995.author: पदार्थः
40001995.content: मन्त्रिसहित: along with counsellors, सबान्धव: with relations, स: king Dasaratha, वाक्यविदाम् among those skilled speech, श्रेष्ठ: excellent, राजा king, वैदेहम् addressing, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40001995.author: Translation
40001995.content: The king (Dasaratha), skilled in speech, accompanied by counsellors and kins said to Janaka,the lord of the Videhas:

40001996.author: पदार्थः
40001996.content: महाराज O Great king, भगवान् venerable, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta,  इक्ष्वाकुकुलदैवतम् spiritual protector of Ikshvaku race, सर्वेषु in all, कृत्येषु ceremonies, वक्ता spokesman, ते to you, विदितम् is known.

40001996.author: Translation
40001996.content: "O Great king venerable Vasishta is the spiritual protector of the Ikshvakus race and it is known that for all ceremonies he is our spokesman".

40001997.author: पदार्थः
40001997.content: सर्वै: by all, महर्षिभि: सह along with maharshis, विश्वामित्राभ्यनुज्ञात: having been permitted by Visvamitra, धर्मात्मा virtuous, एष: वसिष्ठ: this Vasishta, यथाक्रमम् in detailed order, मे my (race), वक्ष्यति will tell you.

40001997.author: Translation
40001997.content: "Having been permitted by Viswamitra, along with all maharshis virtuous Vasishta will tell you in detail about my race".

40001998.author: पदार्थः
40001998.content: नरश्रेष्ठे when the best among men, दशरथे Dasaratha, महात्मनाम् of the distinguished, राज्ञाम् kings, मध्ये amidst, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, तूष्णींभूते remained silent, वाक्यज्ञ: wellversed in speech, भगवान् adorable, वसिष्ठ: ऋषिः Vasishta, सपुरोधसम् in the company of priests, वैदेहम् Janaka, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.

40001998.author: Translation
40001998.content: Having said this amidst the best of men and the most distinguished among kings, Dasaratha remained silent. Then Vasishta, the venerable sage, wellversed in speech spoke to the Lord of Videhas (Janaka) in the midst of priests.

40001999.author: पदार्थः
40001999.content: नरश्रेष्ठे when the best among men, दशरथे Dasaratha, महात्मनाम् of the distinguished, राज्ञाम् kings, मध्ये amidst, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, तूष्णींभूते remained silent, वाक्यज्ञ: wellversed in speech, भगवान् adorable, वसिष्ठ: ऋषिः Vasishta, सपुरोधसम् in the company of priests, वैदेहम् Janaka, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.

40001999.author: Translation
40001999.content: Having said this amidst the best of men and the most distinguished among kings, Dasaratha remained silent. Then Vasishta, the venerable sage, wellversed in speech spoke to the Lord of Videhas (Janaka) in the midst of priests.

40002000.author: पदार्थः
40002000.content: अव्यक्तप्रभव: the unmanifest, शाश्वत: eternal, नित्य: constant, अव्यय: Imperishable, ब्रह्मा Brahma, तस्मात् from him, मरीचि: Marichi, संजज्ञे was born, मरीचे: from Marichi, काश्यप: Kasyapa, सुत: son (sprang).

40002000.author: Translation
40002000.content: "From the unmanifest was born the eternal, the constant, the imperishable Brahma. To him was born Marichi and to Marichi, Kasyapa.

40002001.author: पदार्थः
40002001.content: काश्यपात् from Kasyapa, विवस्वान् Vivasvan, जज्ञे was begotten, वैवस्वत: as Vivasvata, मनु: Manu, स्मृत: said, मनु: Manu, पूर्वम् formerly, प्रजापति: prajapati, इक्ष्वाकु: Ikshavaku, मनो: Manu's, सुत: son.

40002001.author: Translation
40002001.content: Kasyapa begot Vivasvan and Vivasvan, Manu. Ikshavaku was the son of Manu otherwise called Prajapati or Vaivasvata.

40002002.author: पदार्थः
40002002.content: तम् इक्ष्वाकुम् him as Ikshvaku, अयोध्यायाम् in the city of Ayodhya, पूर्वकम् राजानम् ancestral  king, विद्धि be informed, श्रीमान् the glorious, कुक्षिरित्येव known as Kukshi, विश्रुत: wellknown, इक्ष्वाको: Ikshvaku's, सुत: son(was born).

40002002.author: Translation
40002002.content: It may be noted that Ikshvaku was the first ancestral king of Ayodhya whose son was the wellknown, glorious Kukshi.

40002003.author: पदार्थः
40002003.content: अथ thereafter, कुक्षे: Kushi's, श्रीमान् prosperous, विकुक्षि: Vikushi, आत्मज: as son, उदपद्यत was born, महातेजा: highly lustrous, प्रतापवान् valourous, बाण: Bana, विकुक्षे: Vikushi's, पुत्र: son.

40002003.author: Translation
40002003.content: Prosperous Vikukshi was Kukshi's son, who brought forth brilliant and powerful Bana.

40002004.author: पदार्थः
40002004.content: महातेजा: highly splendrous, प्रतापवान् valourous, अनरण्य: Anaranya, बाणस्य Bana's, अनरण्यात् from Anaranya, पृथु: Pruthu, जज्ञे born, त्रिशङ्कु: तु Trishanku, पृथो Pruthu's, सुत: son.

40002004.author: Translation
40002004.content: Bana's son was the most brilliant and valiant Anaranya whose son Pruthu was succeeded by Trisanku.

40002005.author: पदार्थः
40002005.content: त्रिशङ्को: of Trishanku, महायशा: highly famous, दुन्दुमार: Dundumara, पुत्र: अभवत् born as a son, मान्धाता known as Mandhata, पृथिवीपति: king, युवनाश्वसुत: son of Yuvanashva, आसीत् was born.

40002005.author: Translation
40002005.content: Trisanku's famous son was Dundumara also known as Yuvanashva whose son was king Mandhata.

40002006.author: पदार्थः
40002006.content: मान्धातु: for Mandhata, सुसन्धि: Susandhi, श्रीमान् venerable, उदपद्यत was born, सुसन्धेरपि for Susandhi, ध्रुवसन्धि: Dhruvasandhi, प्रसेनजित् Prasenajit, द्वौ two, पुत्रौ sons.

40002006.author: Translation
40002006.content: Mandhata's son was prosperous Susandhi who brought forth two sons Dhruvasandhi and Prasenajit.

40002007.author: पदार्थः
40002007.content: ध्रुवसन्धे: तु for Dhruvasandhi, नामत: by name, भरत: नाम known Bharata, यशस्वी illustrious, भरतात् from Bharata, महातेजा: highly vigoruos, असितो नाम named Asita, जातवान् begot.

40002007.author: Translation
40002007.content: To Dhruvasandhi was born the wellknown Bharata who begot the vigorous Asita.

40002008.author: पदार्थः
40002008.content: यस्य for Asita, हैहया: Haihayas, तालजंघाश्च Talajanghas, शूरा: valiant men, शशिबिन्दवश्च Sasibindus, एते प्रतिराजान: kings fighting against him, शत्रव: enemies, उदपद्यन्त arose.

40002008.author: Translation
40002008.content: Valiant kings belonging to the races of the Haihayas, Talaiangha, and Sasibindus   became  the enemies to Asita.

40002009.author: पदार्थः
40002009.content: स: राजा that king, तान् them, युद्धे in the conflict, प्रतियुध्यन् fighting against them, प्रवासित: was exiled from his kingdom, राजा असित: king Asita, अल्पबल: with relatively lesser strength, मन्त्रिभि: with counsellors, सहित: accompanied, तदा then, हिमवन्तम् towards Himavat mountain, उपागम्य having reached, भृगुप्रस्रवणे in a place known as Bhriguprasravana, अवसत् lived.

40002009.author: Translation
40002009.content: The king Asita who was a weakling was defeated in the conflict against the kings and was exiled. Along with his counsellors he lived at on the Bhriguprasravana Himavat mountain.

40002010.author: पदार्थः
40002010.content: अस्य his, द्वे two, भार्ये wives, गर्भिण्यौ pregnant, बभूवतु: became, इति thus, श्रुतम् is known, एका one, गर्भविनाशाय to destroy the embryo, सपत्नयै the other wife, सगरम् poison mixed in food, ददौ gave.

40002010.author: Translation
40002010.content: It is said that his (Asita's) two wives were pregnant. One gave food mixed with poison to the other with the intention of destroying her embryo.

40002011.author: पदार्थः
40002011.content: तत: afterwards, रम्यम् delightful, शैलवरम् best of mountains, अभिरत: relished, भार्गव: of the family of Bhrigu, च्यवनो नाम named Chyavana, हिमवन्तम् Himavt, उपाश्रित: has taken refuge.

40002011.author: Translation
40002011.content: At that time Chyavana of the family of Bhrigu liked to stay at Himavat, the great, pleasant mountain.

40002012.author: पदार्थः
40002012.content: महाभागा highly accomplished, तत्र (तयो:) एका one of those two, पद्मपत्राक्षी lotuseyed, आत्मन: for her, सुतम् son, काङ्क्षन्ती desiring, देववर्चसम् resembling the lustre of devatas, भार्गवम् Chyavana, ववन्दे offered salutations.

40002012.author: Translation
40002012.content: That the lotuseyed and highly accomplished Kalindi, offered herself for a son to Chyavana who was glowing like a god.

40002013.author: पदार्थः
40002013.content: सा that, कालिंदी च Kalindi also, तम् that, ऋषिम् ascetic, अभ्युपागम्य after approaching, अभ्यवादयत् paid obeisance, स: that, विप्र: brahmin, ताम् her, पुत्रेप्सुम् desiring son, पुत्रजन्मनि concerning the birth of a son to her, अभ्यवदत् spoke.

40002013.author: Translation
40002013.content: Having approached the ascetic. Kalindi paid obeisance to him who said:

40002014.author: पदार्थः
40002014.content: महाभागे O Prosperous one, तव your, कुक्षौ in womb, सुमहाबल: having great prowess, महातेजा: highly lustrous, सुपुत्र: virtuous child, श्रीमान् glorious, गरेण with poison, सहित: furnished, अचिरात् in a short time, सञ्जनिष्यति will be born, कमलेक्षणे O Lotus eyedone,  मा शुच: do not grieve.

40002014.author: Translation
40002014.content: 'O Great lady a child of high prowess, lustre and virtues is growing in your womb. In a short time this glorious son carrying with him the poison (administered to you) will be born. O Lotuseyed lady, do not grieve'.

40002015.author: पदार्थः
40002015.content: महाभागे O Prosperous one, तव your, कुक्षौ in womb, सुमहाबल: having great prowess, महातेजा: highly lustrous, सुपुत्र: virtuous child, श्रीमान् glorious, गरेण with poison, सहित: furnished, अचिरात् in a short time, सञ्जनिष्यति will be born, कमलेक्षणे O Lotus eyedone,  मा शुच: do not grieve.

40002015.author: Translation
40002015.content: 'O Great lady a child of high prowess, lustre and virtues is growing in your womb. In a short time this glorious son carrying with him the poison (administered to you) will be born. O Lotuseyed lady, do not grieve'.

40002016.author: पदार्थः
40002016.content: राजपुत्री princess, पतिव्रता chaste and virtuous one, पतिशोकातुरा afflicted with the sorrow due to loss of her husband, देवी that eldest queen, च्यवनम् Chyavana, नमस्कृत्य having saluted him, तस्मात् for that husband, पुत्रम् son, व्यजायत gave birth.

40002016.author: Translation
40002016.content: This eldest queen who was a devoted wife, afflicted with sorrow due to loss of her husband  gave birth to a son by the grace of  Chyavana.

40002017.author: पदार्थः
40002017.content: सपत्न्या by her rival queen, तस्यै for her, गर्भजिघांसया with the intention of destroying embryo, गर: poison, दत्त: was given, तेन by that, गरेण सह एव with poison itself, जात: was born, स: that, सगर: sagara, अभवत् became.

40002017.author: Translation
40002017.content: Since poison was given to her by  her rival queen with the intention of destroying the   embryo, the son was born with poison and so came to be known as Sagara.

40002018.author: पदार्थः
40002018.content: असमञ्ज: Asamanjasa, सगरस्य Sagara's, तथा also, असमञ्जात् from Asamanja, अंशुमान् Anshuman, दिलीप: Dilipa, अंशुमत: Anshuman's, पुत्र: son, भगीरथ: Bhagiratha, दिलीपस्य Dilipa's (son).

40002018.author: Translation
40002018.content: Asamanja was the son of Sagara and to him was born Anshuman. Dilipa was the son of Anshuman and father of Bhagiratha.

40002019.author: पदार्थः
40002019.content: भगीरथात् from Bhagiratha, ककुत्स्थ: Kakutsthsa, रघु: Raghu, ककुत्स्थस्य Kakutsthsa's, सुत: son, तेजस्वी powerful, प्रवृद्ध: Pravriddha, रघो: Raghu's, पुत्र: son, पुरुषादक: Purushadaka, कल्माषपाद: Kalmashapada, अभवत् became, तस्मात् for him, शंखण: Samkhana, जात: was born.

40002019.author: Translation
40002019.content: Bhagiratha begot Kakustha whose son was Raghu. Powerful Pravriddha was Raghu's son. He became Purushadaka (cannibal), on the curse of Vasistha. He grasped water in order to retaliate Vasishta but was prevented by  his wife. The water fell on his feet and he came to be known as Kalmashapada (feet polluted with water). Samkhana was born to him.

40002020.author: पदार्थः
40002020.content: शङ्घणस्य for Samkhana, सुदर्शन: Sudarsana, सुदर्शनात् from Sudarsana, अग्निवर्ण: Agnivarna, अग्निवर्णस्य for AgniVarna, शीघ्रग: Sighraga, शीघ्रगस्य for sighraga, मरु: Maru, सुत: son, मरो: for Maru, प्रशुश्रुक: Prasusruka, प्रशुश्रुकात् from Prasusukra, अम्बरीष: Ambarisha, आसीत् were born.

40002020.author: Translation
40002020.content: Sudarsana was the son of Samkhana. His son was Agnivarna. To Agnivarna was  born Sighraga and to Sighraga, Maru. To Maru, was born Prasusruka and to Prasrusuka, Ambarisha.

40002021.author: पदार्थः
40002021.content: शङ्घणस्य for Samkhana, सुदर्शन: Sudarsana, सुदर्शनात् from Sudarsana, अग्निवर्ण: Agnivarna, अग्निवर्णस्य for AgniVarna, शीघ्रग: Sighraga, शीघ्रगस्य for sighraga, मरु: Maru, सुत: son, मरो: for Maru, प्रशुश्रुक: Prasusruka, प्रशुश्रुकात् from Prasusukra, अम्बरीष: Ambarisha, आसीत् were born.

40002021.author: Translation
40002021.content: Sudarsana was the son of Samkhana. His son was Agnivarna. To Agnivarna was  born Sighraga and to Sighraga, Maru. To Maru, was born Prasusruka and to Prasrusuka, Ambarisha.

40002022.author: पदार्थः
40002022.content: पृथिवीपति: king, नहुष: Nahusha, अम्बरीषस्य Ambarisha's, पुत्र: son, अभूत् became, नहुषस्य Nahusha's, ययाति: Yayati was born, नाभाग: Nabhaga , ययातिज: was born to Yayati.

40002022.author: Translation
40002022.content: King Nahusha was the son of  Ambarisha. To Nahusha was born Yayati whose son was Nabhaga.

40002023.author: पदार्थः
40002023.content: नाभागस्य Nabhaga's, अज: Aja, बभूव was born, अजात् from Aja, दशरथ: Dasaratha, अभवत् was born, अस्मात् from this, दशरथात् from Dasaratha, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, जातौ were born.

40002023.author: Translation
40002023.content: Nabhaga's son was Aja. Aja was the father of Dasaratha and Dasaratha, the father of  Rama and Lakshmana.
